facts.text: Serve the steak when Leonard opens the Jaguar's trunk.
facts.why: The money is in the Jaguar's trunk (Filmsite) and Jimmy tells Leonard 'I've got 200 grand stashed in the car', but no source I opened shows Leonard opening the trunk on screen. The writer flagged the same doubt.
facts.fix: Serve the steak when Jimmy offers Leonard the 200 grand in the car.

notes: Discount Inn rooms 21 and 304, Burt, Ferdy's Bar, the Sammy Jankis hand tattoo and Teddy's Polaroid text confirmed on Filmsite. Transcript has 'Fact 6, car license SG137IU' and Jimmy's '200 grand stashed in the car'. The cue prints on the phone only, not on the card faces.

vibe.verdict: The Discount Inn postcard with Burt's second room, Sammy Jankis and Teddy's Polaroid feels right, but the food is generic and the film's one great food moment is missing.
